mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRODUCT_REVIEW ( review_id, product_id, store_id, order_item_id, writer_user_id, rating, title, content, image_url, product_tags, created_date ) VALUES ( PRODUCT_REVIEW_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{productId}, #{storeId}, #{orderItemId}, #{writerUserId}, #{rating}, #{title}, #{content}, #{imageUrl}, #{productTags}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select:
SELECT r.review_id AS reviewId, r.product_id AS productId, r.store_id AS storeId, r.order_item_id AS orderItemId, r.writer_user_id AS writerUserId, r.rating, r.title, r.content, r.image_url AS imageUrl, r.is_visible AS isVisible, r.created_date AS createdDate, r.updated_date AS updatedDate, r.reply, r.product_tags AS productTags,
CASE WHEN rl.user_no IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS liked,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_like WHERE review_id = r.review_id ) AS likeCount
FROM product_review r
LEFT JOIN review_like rl ON r.review_id = rl.review_id AND rl.user_no = #{userNo}
WHERE r.product_id = #{productId} AND r.is_visible = 'Y'
AND (r.title LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR r.content LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY
r.created_date DESC r.rating DESC r.review_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE product_review SET reply = #{reply}, updated_date = SYSDATE WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}
mapper.select: SELECT s.store_id FROM product p JOIN store s ON p.producer_id = s.producer_id WHERE p.product_id = #{productId}

SELECT r.review_id AS reviewId, r.product_id AS productId, r.store_id AS storeId, r.order_item_id AS orderItemId, r.writer_user_id AS writerUserId, r.rating AS rating, r.title AS title, r.content AS content, r.image_url AS imageUrl, r.is_visible AS isVisible, r.created_date AS createdDate, r.updated_date AS updatedDate, r.reply AS reply, r.product_tags AS productTags FROM product_review r WHERE r.store_id = #{storeId} ORDER BY r.created_date DESC
